source_refs.note: Example 25.2.2 C₆H₅-NH₂ (aniline, TM): a main subheading of 25.2 Retrosynthesis and Synthesis of Some Compounds, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 137-137.

blocks.text: Yahan retrosynthesis ka pehla step FGI hai: amino group (NH₂) ko nitro (NO₂) group mein badla jata hai. Wajah yeh hai ke nitro group benzene par electrophilic substitution se aasani se lag jata hai, jab ke amino group nucleophilic substitution se nahi lagaya ja sakta.
Doosre step mein nitrobenzene ka C–N bond toora gaya. Is se do synthons bane: aryl anion (C₆H₅⁻) aur nitronium (NO₂⁺) cation.

In synthons ko neutral kar ke synthetic equivalents milte hain: benzene aur nitric acid. Synthesis mein benzene ki HNO₃/H₂SO₄ se nitration hoti hai aur phir nitrobenzene Sn + HCl se reduce ho kar aniline ban jata hai.

blocks.alt: Step I: aniline (NH2 wala benzene) aur open arrow 'FGI' nitrobenzene tak. Step II: nitrobenzene ke C-N bond par wavy slash, 'Disconnection' arrow, phir negative charge wala benzene ring synthon (A) aur positive charge wala NO2 synthon (B). Step III: benzene (H dikhaya gaya), arrow ke oopar HNO3 aur neeche H2SO4, se nitrobenzene, phir Sn + HCl se aniline.
